notes.title: Apotheosis Demo Feedback thread
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
My name is Gabriel. I've been making this game for a while now, and after publishing the Demo it was the first time I had this much people test out the game, and that brought a few problems and bugs to my attention. I've been releasing small updates and bug fixes based on the feedback I got from social media. But I think there are a lot of people that played the game that may not be on those platforms and may have some unadressed issues. 
Even if that's not the case, I'd love to know what you think of the Demo and how far you made it in the game!
